verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm that sells legal advisory services, not a software platform with a UI whose features could be mirrored in an API, so API/UI parity is the wrong axis for this kind of product. The evidence shows no API-shipping capability that would make the axis apply after all. The few web resources it offers (an investor-readiness checker, a UPC decision tracker, downloadable cap tables) are content and marketing tools, not a programmable product surface.
